title: Exhibit B8: Example of an IBM Card with annotated sighting-data fields
description: Page printed sideways and captioned "EXHIBIT B8 / EXAMPLE OF AN IBM CARD", showing a punched IBM card with leader lines naming the data field coded in each column group. Labels include Serial Number, Observed date and G.C. time, Latitude, Longitude, Strategic Area, Angle of Elevation of the Sun, Duration of Observation, Shape, Light Color, Speed, Maneuvers, Observer Reliability and Final Identification. The page is numbered "315 and 316".
